title: leucanthemum maximum subsp. subglaucum
intro: Leucanthemum maximum subsp. subglaucum, commonly known as the pale oxeye daisy, is a subspecies of the white daisy that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is a flowering plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. The health benefits of Leucanthemum maximum subsp. subglaucum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help reduce symptoms of anxiety and improve overall well-being. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are thought to be responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its sedative and anti-anxiety effects.
